\section[kiṭakka]{\ml{കിടക്ക} (kiṭakka) — a bed}

\label{lesson:ML-C129-bed}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for the bathroom, then the Malayalam for the front yard.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{കിടക്ക}}
\textbf{\ml{കിടക്ക}} (\emph{kiṭakka}) — \textquotedblleft{}a bed\textquotedblright{}, the first thing in a \textbf{\ml{മുറി}}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
Where the sleeping happens.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kiṭakka}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kiṭakka}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{kiṭakka}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for the bathroom, then the Malayalam for the front yard, then say \emph{kiṭakka} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{കിടക്ക} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A bed\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[tākkōl]{\ml{താക്കോൽ} (tākkōl) — a key}

\label{lesson:ML-C129-key}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for the front yard, then the Malayalam for a bed.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{താക്കോൽ}}
\textbf{\ml{താക്കോൽ}} (\emph{tākkōl}) — \textquotedblleft{}a key\textquotedblright{}. \textbf{\ml{താക്കോൽ} \ml{എവിടെ}?} — \textquotedblleft{}where is the key?\textquotedblright{}, the question every house hears.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
The thing that is always lost.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{tākkōl}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{tākkōl}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} ask \emph{tākkōl evide?}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for the front yard, then the Malayalam for a bed, then say \emph{tākkōl} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{താക്കോൽ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A key\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
